name: intel_api_5xx
description: intel_api_5xx: More than one percent of read-API requests answered 5xx over five minutes. Severity ticket. Runbook: docs/runbooks/oncall-alerts.md#api-error-rate

name: intel_api_panic
description: intel_api_panic: A handler crashed mid-request; the client got a 500 and the panic value was not logged. Severity page. Runbook: docs/runbooks/oncall-alerts.md#api-panic

name: intel_api_requests
description: Count of read-API requests logged by intel-api. Denominator of the API error-rate alert (intel #54). The request line carries the route pattern, status, size and duration only: never a path, body or address. Runbook: docs/runbooks/oncall-alerts.md#api-error-rate

name: intel_api_stopped
description: intel_api_stopped: intel-api exited non-zero, so the read API is down. Severity page. Runbook: docs/runbooks/oncall-alerts.md#api-stopped

name: intel_ingest_halt
description: intel_ingest_halt: intel-worker exited because a ledger could not be ingested correctly. Nothing new is being recorded. Severity page. Runbook: docs/runbooks/oncall-alerts.md#ingest-halt

name: intel_ledger_gap
description: intel_ledger_gap: A halt whose cause is a missing ledger: the checkpoint's next sequence is not what the source serves. Severity page. Runbook: docs/runbooks/oncall-alerts.md#ledger-gap

name: intel_ledger_processed
description: intel_ledger_processed: No ledger was processed for fifteen minutes without a halt being reported: the worker is stuck, not stopped. Severity page. Runbook: docs/runbooks/oncall-alerts.md#ingest-lag

name: intel_snapshot_publish_failed
description: intel_snapshot_publish_failed: One publish attempt failed and the loop retries at the next tick. One is noise; a run of them is the stale-snapshot alert. Severity ticket. Runbook: docs/runbooks/oncall-alerts.md#snapshot-publish-failed

name: intel_snapshot_published
description: intel_snapshot_published: No snapshot has been published in twice the publish interval, so Guard clients are approaching their max-age refusal. Severity page. Runbook: docs/runbooks/oncall-alerts.md#snapshot-stale

name: intel_snapshot_rejected
description: intel_snapshot_rejected: A recorded snapshot's file is missing or disagrees with its row, so the API answered 503 instead of serving unverified bytes. Severity page. Runbook: docs/runbooks/oncall-alerts.md#snapshot-file-rejected

name: intel_snapshot_sign_failed
description: intel_snapshot_sign_failed: The signing call failed, so no new snapshot exists. Guard keeps using the last one until it goes stale. Severity page. Runbook: docs/runbooks/oncall-alerts.md#snapshot-sign-failed

name: intel_unclassified_alert
description: intel_unclassified_alert: A log line asked for an operator but named an alert id the taxonomy does not list, so nothing else would have fired. Severity ticket. Runbook: docs/runbooks/oncall-alerts.md#unclassified-alert

name: intel_writer_lock_lost
description: intel_writer_lock_lost: The Postgres advisory lock that makes one process the writer for a network went away, so a second writer could start. Severity page. Runbook: docs/runbooks/oncall-alerts.md#writer-lock-lost

name: intel_xdr_unsupported
description: intel_xdr_unsupported: A halt whose cause is XDR: an unknown structure, a protocol newer than this build's pin, or a value that breaks a ledger rule. Severity page. Runbook: docs/runbooks/oncall-alerts.md#xdr-unsupported
